images.alt_text: A tranquil mountain lake below steep volcanic cliffs in the South Warner Wilderness. A horse stands at the water's edge drinking, with patches of lingering summer snow scattered across the rocky slopes behind it. Bright turquoise water, rugged ridgelines, and sparse trees create a remote, high-elevation alpine scene.
